scripts.label: Explanation frame capture move ordinary
scripts.text: This move captures a piece.

scripts.label: Explanation frame capture move check
scripts.text: This captures a piece and gives check as well.

scripts.label: Explanation frame capture move mate
scripts.text: This captures a piece and delivers checkmate. The king has no way to escape.

scripts.label: Explanation frame capture move escape
scripts.text: This captures a piece and gets the king out of check.

scripts.label: Explanation finding fork collected
scripts.text: Watch the fork at work: the same piece attacks several targets, then takes one. The example also shows a net material gain.

scripts.label: Explanation finding pin collected
scripts.text: Watch the pinned piece here. It cannot leave the line without exposing its king, and it gets captured as these moves play out.

scripts.label: Explanation finding skewer collected
scripts.text: Watch the front piece move aside. That opens the way for a capture of the piece behind it, along the same line.

scripts.label: Explanation finding king skewer collected
scripts.text: In this example, the king steps out of check and off the line. The same attacker then takes the piece behind it.

scripts.label: Explanation finding sole defender captured
scripts.text: Follow the captures: first the only defender, then the piece it was guarding. Notice what the first capture makes possible.

scripts.label: Explanation finding deflection collected
scripts.text: Watch the defender move away from its job. The piece it leaves behind is then captured.

scripts.label: Explanation finding discovered capture
scripts.text: Moving the blocker opens an attack from another piece. Watch that piece make the capture along the newly opened line.

scripts.label: Explanation finding double check
scripts.text: Watch for the double check: both pieces give check at the same time.

scripts.label: Explanation finding double attack collected
scripts.text: Watch the threats work together: the moved piece attacks one target, and another attacks along the newly opened line. That second attack wins material in this example.

scripts.label: Explanation finding promotion material retained
scripts.text: Watch the pawn promote. This example also shows a net material gain for that side.

scripts.label: Explanation finding undefended capture gain
scripts.text: Look at the undefended piece being captured. The example shows a net material gain for the capturing side.

scripts.label: Game explanation legal reply
scripts.text: The other side can play the reply marked on the board. Try it and see what happens next.

scripts.label: Explanation note strong replies
scripts.text: These moves show how play could go against strong replies. Don't assume each reply is forced.
